scope: Read-only frozen Android293; no auth/network/official execution/native session; no credentials inspected or product edits
welcome: ckn -> pu71.c LoginScreen -> xu71; redesigned z770 landing conditional on original capability. Native welcome can be reconstructed. Login/another-way/Google/remembered-account and optional guest entry have conditional visibility; no universal provider button order.
native_boundary: Native welcome/buttons confirmed. No original native email+password form proven. Username-Password-Authentication is an auth strategy for authorization handoff; it is not proof of a native credential screen. Google ID-token support separately exists. Apple/Microsoft/etc model does not establish a visible welcome button.
web_auth: o151 launches WebAuthenticationActivity; supports Auth Tab and Custom Tab fallback. WebRedirectActivity forwards custom-scheme callback then closes. Manifest com.openai.chatgpt scheme, hosts auth0.openai.com/auth0-dev.openai.com/auth.openai.com/auth.api.openai.org, pathPrefix /android/com.openai.chatgpt/callback. Runtime o151 validates exact configured redirect scheme/host/path and current state before accepting nonblank code.
identity: One current m151 session; new launch cancels old session. Completion/cleanup compares session object. PKCE S256,state,nonce parameters recovered. Never count browser open/close or presence of callback URI as login success. Token exchange/session acceptance remains separate.
scope_warning: Declared first-party scopes are evidence only, not an authorization grant or a recommended integration request. Independent host needs its own legitimate issuer/client/redirect and least required scope; cannot reuse official credentials or callback namespace.
account_settings: Root conditional vat0 logout -> gbt0 -> sa.t -> cmn0 case4 w8t0 -> yw starts xw. Account login event r8t0 routes y4v. Real logout remote revocation/browser-cookie handling/local multi-account cleanup not closed.
minimum_independent_contract: Native signed-out welcome plus explicit local/synthetic account adapter is feasible; label synthetic session distinctly.
Implement browser auth only with a separately configured provider; do not create fake native password fields or pretend official login succeeded.
Scope account data and subscriptions by accepted account/session; retire old in-flight auth result after replacement.
Expose cancelled/unavailable/failure separately; do not clear user files merely to simulate logout.
